'''''Reflections on Xim''''' was an exhibition room during the auction of the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]] with items from [[Xim/Legends|Xim's]] reign in the [[Figg & Associates Art Museum]] located in the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].
